item.title: Sudo for Windows (2024)
item.description:
📝 Sudo for Windows Welcome to the repository for Sudo for Windows 🥪. Sudo for Windows allows users to run elevated commands directly from unelevated terminal windows. Instead, Sudo for Windows is a Windows-specific implementation of the sudo concept.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/microsoft/sudo
